youtube.title: Why Pen Caps Have A Tiny Hole 😮 #Shorts #science #facts #didyouknow
youtube.description:
A tiny hole in pen caps isn't for the ink. It's there so you can still breathe if you swallow one. 😮

Pen-cap holes are a safety standard (ISO 11540): a cap small enough to swallow must let air through.

Most people think the hole is there so the ink doesn't dry out or so the cap clicks on. The real reason is safety: children chew and swallow pen caps, and an open channel lets enough air pass to keep breathing until help arrives.

Watch our full episodes on the channel.
